violated_contract: A row derived from source records (a conversations-v3 conversation built from recordings) owns the evidence those sources hold for the content it copied. Comparing a receipt's owner id against the derived row's own id treats its own sources as a merge, so every derived row silently abstains from the evidence path (batch speaker resolution and the final pass refused 24 of 24 fresh v3 rows on 2026-11-26).
canonical_prevention: Qualify receipt ownership by the row's declared derivation (database/batch_final_pass.receipt_owners over v3_recording_ids), keep shared-unit and privacy fences over that whole owner set, carry only the row's own content from a source (own-speech mask), re-check the source's live claim after inference, and prove it red-first with a lab scenario that writes receipts the way production's projection does.
